meta.source: FIADB WA_PLOT.csv + WA_COND.csv, most-recent INVYR, area-weighted
meta.coord_note: Public FIADB PLOT LAT/LON, which the Forest Service perturbs (fuzzed up to about 1.6 km, most within 0.8 km) and swaps for a subset of private plots. These are NOT true plot locations. Rounded to 0.01 degree (about 1 km) so the stored precision does not imply more accuracy than the source has.
